clause.quote: Therefore all CESR primitives MUST employ [[ref: mid-padding]] as defined.

description: An A# indexed signature whose pad bits, between the index and the value, are not zero. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject an indexed signature whose pad bits are not zero
